title: = I33a: intent contracts (format, registry, derivation of L_weak, the run's marking), G10, intended_bounded in the v2 records, the volatile-view contract type and the Q4 adoption package, exercised on the toy milestone T64

predictions.claim: On the test milestone T64 (tests_m3/fixtures/contracts/: one pending batch whose deadline every challenge extends by W = 3 and a cancel leaves extended), the existing generators and refuters decide: L_t64_cancel (the undo pair (challenge, cancel) under every later schedule) REFUTED; L_t64_flag (a planted false invariant) REFUTED; L_contract_C_t64_ext (C_t64_ext's L_weak: from every reachable state, after (challenge, cancel) the deadline is exactly 3 later, no challenge is open, and the commit time and the flag are unchanged) PROVED. Each record's proof or counter-law is accepted by Bend on a re-check in the test, states exactly its law, and came from a generator or refuter that existed at the prereg; gate checks G1, G3, G5 and G11 pass on T64.

With C_t64_ext and V_t64_view registered, holon run --milestone T64 marks L_t64_cancel's record filter_bin intended_bounded with intended {contract C_t64_ext, l_weak L_contract_C_t64_ext, replaces: the record's filter_bin in a run with no contract}, and the record is otherwise that run's record; L_t64_flag's record is that run's record (both but for wall-clock fields); the run with no contract writes no results/T64/contracts.json; G10 passes on T64, from the gate and from the instrument (tests_m3/_i64.g10).

With the planted false contract C_t64_zero (L_weak: the cancel leaves no residue on the deadline) in place of C_t64_ext, L_contract_C_t64_zero is REFUTED (its counter-law accepted by Bend on a re-check), L_t64_cancel is not marked intended_bounded and carries no intended, and G10 fails naming C_t64_zero, from the gate and from the instrument (whose reasons include 'C_t64_zero: not proved: REFUTED').

A change of the toy's facts makes G10 fail as stale, from the gate and from the instrument. After a change that leaves the toy's behaviour (the doc text of action raise), holon contracts derive and holon run leave C_t64_ext's L_weak PROVED and G10 passing, with L_t64_cancel marked. After W changes from 3 to 4, derive and run leave the L_weak (+3) REFUTED, nothing marked, and G10 failing. The L_weak's record is re-checked by Bend after each run, and the gate and the instrument agree at every step.

regressions.claim: I64 registers no contract on M0-M3 and no M0-M3 record is marked intended_bounded or carries intended; G10 is listed under not_applicable on M0 and M1 and passes with no contract on M2 and M3; G10 is in holon.gate.CHECK_ORDER and holon.sorts.gate3.CHECK_ORDER.

Gates M0, M1 and M2 pass with G10 added (not_applicable on M0 and M1). The M3 partial gate passes every check but G11V, which fails only on L_disch_rev_initializable_120_d9a34b48, as on the base (CI run 39650731101; Q36), and its G10 passes. The frozen suite, freeze-check and holon audit prereg (M2, M3) pass. No commit of I64's own (the non-merge commits of git log --first-parent from the prereg commit to the first that adds docs/iterations/I64.md) changes laws/M0-M3, results/M0-M3, gen/M0-M3, spec/M1, spec/M2, holon/rules/, replay/, a frozen root, or a file of a generator closure (the holon-ir/0.1-0.3 closures and the typed runners', so every M0-M3 record keeps its generator_sha256), renames counted at both ends; and at least one of them writes an I64 outcome path.

regressions.claim: Construction checks, not counted: the fixture validates (laws and the contracts' L_weak against IR 0.3; the contracts by the instrument's K1/K9, V_t64_bad invalid); holon contracts derive writes the instrument's derived laws, --check reproduces them and sees an edit, and derive removes a gone contract's law; derive refuses V_t64_bad (exit 2, naming it, nothing written) after writing C_t64_ext's law beside V_t64_view; G10 and results/T64/contracts.json agree with the instrument; G10 fails, from the gate and the instrument, on each of twelve tampers of the baseline (registry, records, marks, files); apply --check reproduces the baseline and sees a removed mark, apply restores it and, after a facts change, takes it off; apply refuses (exit 2, nothing written) on half a mark, a record that is not JSON and a missing results directory; the least id names the mark; v2 admits a marked REFUTED record and rejects intended on a PROVED record, an incomplete intended and either half of a mark, while tools/freeze.py check passes; the Q4 package's schemas equal spec/schemas and its README names the freeze steps, the CI digest pin and FROZEN_ROOTS. The tamper and apply checks start from the baseline's passing G10 and the least-id check decides a copy of C_t64_ext's L_weak, so they fail with P2 or P1.
